home.feature_description:
At Threeclipse Studios, we blend creativity with technology to deliver unforgettable gaming experiences. Our dedicated team is passionate, pushing the boundaries of interactive storytelling.

As an indie studio based in Montreal, Canada, we're a nexus of developers and creative minds who strive to sharpen minds and ethics alike.

about.feature_description: At Threeclipse Studios, we blend creativity with technology to deliver unforgettable gaming experiences. Our dedicated team is passionate, pushing the boundaries of interactive storytelling.
about.section_1_content:
I believe in creating games that are not only fun but also meaningful. Quality, integrity, and continuous growth are at the core of everything I do. I value collaboration, clean code, and building experiences that leave a lasting impression on players.

I am committed to pushing my limits, embracing challenges, and always striving to improve both as a developer and as a creator. I believe in giving back to the community, sharing knowledge, and helping others grow in their own game development journeys.
about.section_2_content:
With a strong foundation in game development and programming, my expertise spans across multiple disciplines. I have professional experience with Unity and Godot engines, as well as deep knowledge in custom engine development with Vulkan.

My technical skills include C#, C++, Java, JavaScript, and Python. I specialize in multiplayer networking, AI programming, cross-platform development, and performance optimization. I have successfully published games on Steam, Google Play, and itch.io, and I continue to explore new technologies to expand my capabilities.

I am passionate about creating immersive gameplay, designing intuitive user interfaces, and writing clean, maintainable code that powers unforgettable gaming experiences.

[ { "title": "Geo-Wing", "link": "#", "description": "An arcade space shooter with RPG elements featuring a level-up system, unlockable abilities, passive skills, and attribute progression, built in Unity with custom object pooling, advanced input handling, and complete multiplayer networking.", "fullDescription": "

Geo-Wing is an arcade space shooter that blends classic shmup action with deep RPG progression mechanics. Built in Unity using C#, the game features a complete multiplayer networking system with UDP, custom packet serialization, and time synchronization. It includes a robust input system supporting keyboard, mouse, and multiple gamepads with dynamic device detection and full rebinding capabilities.

RPG Progression System:

  • Level-Up System: Players gain experience points (EXP) from defeating enemies, with a formula-based level-up curve. Each level grants Ability Points (AP) for upgrading character attributes.
  • Attribute Upgrades: Six upgradeable attributes including Weapon Damage, Shield Capacity, Charge Speed, Fire Rate, Dash Efficiency, and Ship Mass, each with 10+ levels of progression.
  • Ability System: Players unlock a chargeable secondary weapon (Bomb) with visual indicators, full charge detection, and networked synchronization for multiplayer.
  • Passive Abilities: Upgradeable passive skills including Auto-Fire mode, Shield regeneration, and movement bonuses that persist across sessions.
  • Player Progression: SQLite-based local database tracks player profiles, high scores, total experience, level, and all attribute upgrades across gaming sessions.

Technical Implementation Highlights:

  • Multiplayer Networking: Complete UDP-based networking with custom packet serialization, ACK system, RTT calculation, and time synchronization between clients and host using NTP-like algorithms.
  • Object Pooling: Custom IPoolable interface with generic pool system for efficient spawning and recycling of projectiles, enemies, and visual effects with active tracking and statistics.
  • Input System: Advanced input handling with support for keyboard, mouse, and up to 4 gamepads with dynamic device detection, automatic controller assignment, and input system vs legacy input coexistence.
  • Rebind System: Full key rebinding with visual button displays using Addressable Assets for controller button sprites, supporting both keyboard and gamepad remapping with D-Pad movement lock.
  • Firing Modes: Multiple weapon modes including Single, Double, Triple, Wide, Fast, and Helix with visual feedback and networked synchronization.
  • Pickup System: Power-up system with weapon upgrades and ship upgrades (Shield, Speed Up, Speed Down, Life, Blank).
  • Shader System: Custom shape shader supporting multiple geometric shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle, torus) with dynamic properties including fill amount, outline, glow, pulse, and dismantle effects.
  • UI System: Unity Timeline-driven UI animations with dynamic panel positioning, responsive layouts, and real-time stat displays for attributes and abilities.
  • Audio System: Audio management with volume sliders, SFX pooling, and charge sound effects with pitch control.
  • Camera System: Camera shake effects with configurable duration and magnitude for impact feedback.

The project demonstrates professional game development practices including singleton pattern for core systems, event-driven architecture, async asset loading with Addressables, comprehensive UI management, and persistent player progression with SQLite database integration.

" }, { "title": "Syzygy Tactics", "link": "#", "description": "A turn-based strategy game developed in Unity with a service-oriented architecture, featuring AI opponents, unit transformation systems, and dynamic asset management via Addressables.", "fullDescription": "

Syzygy Tactics is a turn-based strategy game built in Unity using C#. The project implements a modular architecture with the Service Locator pattern for dependency management and an event-driven system using a custom event bus (GameEvents) for decoupled communication between systems.

Technical Implementation Highlights:

  • Architecture: Service Locator pattern with interfaces (IGameStateService, IPlayerService, ITileService, IUnitService, ICursorService, IUIService) for loose coupling and testability
  • Asset Management: Addressable Assets System for dynamic loading of sprites, audio, prefabs, and Timeline assets with memory caching and async loading
  • AI System: Custom AI with priority queue BFS pathfinding, tactical decision-making, and priority-based objective targeting with combat prediction
  • UI System: Timeline-driven UI animations via PlayableDirector with dynamic panel positioning and responsive layout based on screen space
  • Data-Driven Design: JSON-based unit configuration system with inheritance and runtime application, including attack modifiers, movement types, and transformation stats
  • Event System: Static GameEvents class with 70+ events for system communication, enabling clean separation of concerns
  • Unit System: Abstract base class with 12+ derived unit types (Infantry, Tank, Artillery, Helicopter, Transport, Hero, etc.) featuring secondary weapons, counter-attack mechanics, and type-based damage modifiers
  • Transformation System: Runtime unit mutation and mechanization with stat modifications, movement type changes, and persistent tracking
  • Visual Novel Integration: JSON-driven narrative system with character portraits, backgrounds, audio, and branching dialogue, loading all assets via Addressables
  • Pathfinding: BFS-based pathfinding with tile cost calculations, fuel constraints, and terrain-based movement costs loaded from JSON

The project demonstrates professional game development practices including singleton pattern for core systems, priority queues for AI decision making, async asset loading with error handling, and comprehensive UI management with real-time unit status updates.

" }, { "title": "Pokémon Championship 2026", "link": "#", "description": "A cinematic presentation system built in Unity utilizing Timeline for synchronized cutscenes, with dual-panel visual novel dialogue, JSON-driven narrative flow, typewriter text effects, and confetti celebration mechanics.", "fullDescription": "

Pokémon Championship 2026 is a cinematic presentation system built in Unity using Timeline for synchronized cutscene sequencing. The project demonstrates a complete dialogue management system with dual-panel display, JSON-driven narrative flow, and celebratory confetti effects, all orchestrated through Unity's Timeline system.

Technical Implementation Highlights:

  • Timeline Integration: Full utilization of Unity's PlayableDirector and Timeline assets for cinematic sequencing, with multiple tracks controlling dialogue, animations, and effects.
  • Dual Dialogue System: Two independent VN controllers running simultaneously, each with separate dialogue panels, typewriter effects, and JSON narrative data for split-screen presentation.
  • JSON-Driven Narrative: Complete dialogue system loading from JSON strings with node-based structure supporting branching narratives, character names, and content.
  • Typewriter Effect: Character-by-character text display with configurable typing speed, skip functionality, and completion callbacks triggered by Timeline events.
  • Timeline Event Triggers: Custom Timeline signals and markers to trigger dialogue start, confetti launch, and scene transitions at precise moments in the cutscene.
  • Confetti Launcher: Physics-based confetti particle system with configurable launch parameters including strength, angle spread, gravity, rotation, and sprite randomization.
  • Camera Orbit System: Full 3D camera orbit controls with Timeline-controlled presets, smooth transitions, and orbit locking for cinematic shots.
  • Scene Management: Timeline-driven scene navigation with next/previous scene functionality triggered by Timeline markers.
  • Event Sequencing: Coordinated timing system for dialogue playback and confetti launch with configurable delays, all synchronized through Timeline.

The project demonstrates professional implementation of Unity's Timeline system for cinematic presentation, visual novel mechanics, event-driven presentation systems, and physics-based particle effects.

" }, { "title": "Contra_Remix", "link": "#", "description": "A Contra-inspired 2D action game built in Godot 4 featuring split-screen multiplayer, advanced enemy AI, dynamic power-ups, and a comprehensive gear selection system.", "fullDescription": "

Contra_Remix is a 2D action-platformer built in Godot 4, inspired by the classic Contra series. The game features intense run-and-gun gameplay, split-screen multiplayer support, and a deep gear customization system that modifies player abilities and combat effectiveness.

Technical Implementation Highlights:

  • State Machine Architecture: Complex state machines for player (IDLE, RUN, JUMP, CROUCH, HURT, SHOOT, LOOK_UP/DOWN) and enemies (IDLE, WALK, CHASE, ATTACK, WAIT_TO_ATTACK, HURT) enabling responsive AI and fluid gameplay.
  • Split-Screen Multiplayer: Full split-screen support with independent viewports, HUDs, and input handling for two players simultaneously.
  • LAN Multiplayer: UDP-based networking with server/client architecture, thread-safe peer management, and real-time input synchronization.
  • Gear Selection System: Four equipment slots (Helmet, Body, Arm, Leg) with multiple options: HAT, BRAIN, VISOR, SKULL (helmet); SHEILD, DEFENCE, LIGHT, SLOW (body); STANDARD, DOUBLE, TRIPLE, HELIX, LEMON (weapon); POWER_JUMP, DOUBLE_JUMP, DASH, AIR_DASH (legs).
  • Energy Management: Energy-based special abilities including shield activation, dash mechanics (ground and air), and double jump with energy consumption.
  • Enemy AI System: 10+ enemy types including Red Werewolf, Alien variants (blue, red), Zombie (man, woman), Frog, Eagle, Snail with unique movement patterns and attack behaviors.
  • Shader Effects: Custom flash shader for damage feedback on enemies and breakable objects with real-time parameter updates.
  • Physics System: Custom gravity handling, platform physics with moving platforms, and collision detection using CharacterBody2D.
  • Animation System: Sprite-based animations with frame management for all characters, sprite flipping based on movement direction, and animation state tracking.
  • Scrolling Backgrounds: Parallax scrolling with multiple layers for rich environmental depth across 4 distinct themes.
  • Checkpoint System: Boss-triggered checkpoints with animation sequences and level completion logic.
  • Audio Management: Centralized sound system with volume control for music and SFX, supporting multiple sound cues (laser, damage, pickup, jump, land, game over).
  • Persistent Data: JSON-based high score saving system with file I/O operations.
  • Vim Editor Integration: Custom Godot plugin providing Vim-like key bindings for script editing with motion commands, operators, actions, macros, bookmarks, and jump lists.

The project demonstrates professional Godot 4 development practices including scene composition, signal-based communication, singleton patterns, resource management, and modular system design.

Game Features
